shortDescription: Changes the power plan of a Windows system

options.name: guid
options.description: String value that indicates the desired power plan by guid. The power plan must already be present on the system. For out of box guids see U(https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/power/power-policy-settings).

options.name: name
options.description: String value that indicates the desired power plan by name. The power plan must already be present on the system. Commonly there will be options for C(balanced) and C(high performance).
